content.short: Cenoa gives freelancers in emerging markets US and EU accounts plus digital dollar balances to get paid globally.
content.description: Cenoa is a fintech app for freelancers, remote workers and e-exporters in emerging markets such as Turkey, Egypt, Pakistan and Nigeria. It opens free US, EU and UK bank accounts through Stripe's Bridge infrastructure so users can receive international payments with no fees, then hold balances as USDC or USDT digital dollars, convert to local currency, send peer-to-peer payments and earn yield. By pairing real bank accounts with stablecoin balances, Cenoa helps people who earn from abroad avoid high transfer fees and protect savings from local currency swings. It raised 7 million dollars in seed funding led by Quiet Capital and Underscore VC.
